items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions Benny Golson receiving a Grammy award alongside Horace Silver. The interviewee (Chico Hamilton) responds by asking the interviewer to convey a message ('Tell him I met Chico'), indicating he is aware of Golson but no direct personal interaction or professional relationship i

ctx.x: He received it. MR. KIMERY: He’s already received it.

He might be getting another award. I know he got an award -- he got a Grammy award. He got a Lifetime Achievement last year. He did and Benny Golson and Horace. Well anyway, so the next time I see him what?
